title: Aquaculture issue #350: Crash on Startup
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (none) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by StarrSage]
Trying to load this mod gives an error that says "Failed to load correctly java.lang.InvocationTargetException: null"

[comment by GirafiStudios (collaborator)]
Please provide a crash report, otherwise there is nowhere for me to even start attempting to look into the issue.

[comment by StarrSage (none)]
I’ve dealt with this issue on a few of my mods and have learned it has something to do with the mod needing to be updated for Forge. I am currently using the recommended 1.19 version.

[comment by GirafiStudios (collaborator)]
What version of Aquaculture 2 are you using?

[comment by StarrSage (none)]
I was trying to use the latest 1.19 (not 1.19.1) version, 1.19-2.4.4.jar

[comment by GirafiStudios (collaborator)]
There is no 1.19.1 version of Aquaculture 2, the 1.19 versions just work with it as well. Aquaculture 2.4.5 is built against the 1.19 recommended version of Forge.
